slot_scores.name: robot_doll_mutual_exclusion
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether manufacturing robots prevents manufacturing dolls, nor about any robot-doll production restriction. Its later general question about 'other constraints' is too vague to count as targeting this slot.

slot_scores.name: doll_model_car_quantity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about the model car-building block relationship and about integrality/bounds, but never asked whether doll production is capped by the number of model cars produced.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Robots and dolls may be produced simultaneously, with no mutual-exclusion constraint between them.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about robot-doll mutual exclusion, yet its READY_TO_MODEL summary omitted any such restriction and claimed all critical facts had been confirmed.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Doll production is not limited by model car production, and no dolls <= model cars constraint exists.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a dolls-vs-model-cars quantity relationship, yet its READY_TO_MODEL summary omitted any such constraint and claimed all critical facts had been confirmed.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while both P1 hidden business-rule slots were still unresolved and unasked.

summary: The agent clarified the model car-building block implication, integrality, and basic bounds, but missed both hidden P1 business constraints and then declared READY_TO_MODEL. This caused silent assumptions about robot-doll mutual exclusion and a dolls-vs-model-cars quantity limit.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
